run.name: Victory Capital Holdings, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (VCTR)
run.summary: Before the First Eagle acquisition, Victory's debt is small against its earnings: 1.14x gross and 0.90x net of last-twelve-months adjusted EBITDA, with 14.83x cash interest cover. The credit view after closing is open. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA proxy, income from operations plus D&A (calculated), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 975,150 and cash 207,724 at September 30, 2026 over calculated LTM adjusted EBITDA 856,348; excludes the pending First Eagle acquisition and any new debt; cash is consolidated and includes regulated subsidiaries; management non-GAAP measure

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Calculated LTM adjusted EBITDA 856,348 over calculated LTM cash interest 57,742; the nine months of 2025 cash interest base is unusually high in the third quarter of 2025 (see Calculations), which lowers LTM cash interest; not a forecast run rate

cash.basis: Cash. September 30, 2026; same basis; WestEnd contingent consideration of 53.8 US$m is estimated payable over the next year and is not deducted

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: First Eagle financing amounts and terms are not in the sources, and covenant headroom cannot be calculated.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure, and the pending First Eagle acquisition financing is not in the pack.
